---- MODULE W4Od14m1p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Drones == {"d1", "d2", "d3"}
Sectors == {"n", "e", "s"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES holder, owner, active, slow, passes

vars == <<holder, owner, active, slow, passes>>

Ring(d) == CASE d = "d1" -> "d2"
             [] d = "d2" -> "d3"
             [] d = "d3" -> "d1"

Init ==
    /\ holder = "d1"
    /\ owner = [x \in Sectors |-> NONE]
    /\ active = NONE
    /\ slow = {}
    /\ passes = 0

\* The token holder acquires the exclusive survey lock on a free sector.
Claim(sec) ==
    /\ active = NONE
    /\ owner[sec] = NONE
    /\ holder \notin slow
    /\ active' = holder
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![sec] = holder]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, slow, passes>>

\* The surveying drone finishes and drops the exclusive lock (keeps sector).
Finish ==
    /\ active # NONE
    /\ active' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, owner, slow, passes>>

\* Token moves to the next drone in the ring, only when no lock is held.
PassToken ==
    /\ active = NONE
    /\ holder' = Ring(holder)
    /\ passes < 8
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, active, slow>>

\* A drone becomes sluggish (slow but not failed): it cannot claim while slow.
SlowDown(d) ==
    /\ d \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, owner, active, passes>>

\* A slow drone recovers its normal speed.
SpeedUp(d) ==
    /\ d \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, owner, active, passes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E sec \in Sectors : Claim(sec)
    \/ Finish
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E d \in Drones : SlowDown(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : SpeedUp(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Drones
    /\ owner \in [Sectors -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ active \in Drones \cup {NONE}
    /\ slow \subseteq Drones
    /\ passes \in Nat

\* Whoever holds the exclusive survey lock must be the current token holder:
\* no drone allocates a sector unless it possesses the ring token.
LockIsHeldByTokenHolder ==
    active # NONE => (active = holder /\ \E sec \in Sectors : owner[sec] = active)

====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm covers three sectors (north, east, south). The drones d1,d2,d3 form a fixed ring around which a single survey token circulates. Only the drone currently holding the token may acquire the exclusive survey lock and allocate a free sector to itself; while it holds that lock no other drone can allocate. When it finishes, it drops the lock but keeps the sector it recorded. The token advances to the next drone in the ring only when no lock is held. A drone may become sluggish (slow but not failed) and while slow it cannot claim; it later speeds up and resumes normal operation. The token is never lost and no drone ever crashes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A drone may hold the exclusive survey lock only while it is the current token holder, so two drones never allocate the same sector at once.

---- MODULE W4Od5m5p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Lobbies == {"L1", "L2"}
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
TOTAL == 4
QUORUM == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES pool, seats, votes, prop, phase

vars == <<pool, seats, votes, prop, phase>>

Sum == seats["L1"] + seats["L2"]

Init ==
    /\ pool = TOTAL
    /\ seats = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ votes = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ prop = [lob |-> NONE, k |-> 0, kind |-> NONE]
    /\ phase = "idle"

\* Propose moving k queued players into a lobby; opens a voting round.
Propose(l, k) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ k >= 1 /\ k <= pool
    /\ prop' = [lob |-> l, k |-> k, kind |-> "fill"]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, seats>>

\* A voter casts a yes/no ballot once per round.
Vote(v, b) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[v] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![v] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, seats, prop, phase>>

\* Commit the move if a quorum voted yes: players leave the pool for the lobby.
CommitQuorum ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({v \in Voters : votes[v] = "yes"}) >= QUORUM
    /\ pool' = pool - prop.k
    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![prop.lob] = @ + prop.k]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, prop>>

\* A privileged admin forces the pending move through without any quorum.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ pool' = pool - prop.k
    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![prop.lob] = @ + prop.k]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, prop>>

\* Disband a lobby, returning its players to the queue.
Disband(l) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ seats[l] > 0
    /\ pool' = pool + seats[l]
    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![l] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, prop, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies, k \in 1..TOTAL : Propose(l, k)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, b \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(v, b)
    \/ CommitQuorum
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ \E l \in Lobbies : Disband(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in 0..TOTAL
    /\ seats \in [Lobbies -> 0..TOTAL]
    /\ votes \in [Voters -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}

\* No player is created or destroyed: queued plus seated always equals the roster.
PlayersConserved == pool + Sum = TOTAL

====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker holds a fixed roster of four players, each either waiting in the queue or seated in one of two lobbies. Any move of players from the queue into a lobby is decided by quorum voting: a proposal names a lobby and a batch size, voters cast yes/no ballots, and the batch is committed only when at least two voters approve. A privileged admin may override the vote and force a pending move through without any quorum. Lobbies can be disbanded, returning all their players to the queue. Players are only shuffled between the queue and lobbies.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of queued players plus the number seated across all lobbies always equals the fixed roster size, so no player is ever created or lost.

---- MODULE W4Od17m3p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Bags == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
Routers == {"r1", "r2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, atGate, inTransit, delivered, msgs

vars == <<leader, epoch, atGate, inTransit, delivered, msgs>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = "r1"
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ atGate = Bags
    /\ inTransit = {}
    /\ delivered = {}
    /\ msgs = {}

\* The current leader routes a bag off the gate onto the belt and posts a
\* delivery message tagged with its epoch.
Route(b) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ b \in atGate
    /\ atGate' = atGate \ {b}
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit \cup {b}
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[bag |-> b, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, delivered>>

\* Any posted message may be consumed (delivery order is arbitrary), moving its
\* bag from the belt to the claim carousel.
DeliverMsg(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.bag \in inTransit
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit \ {m.bag}
    /\ delivered' = delivered \cup {m.bag}
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, atGate>>

\* The leader fails; routing halts until a successor is elected.
Fail ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, atGate, inTransit, delivered, msgs>>

\* Failover: a router is elected leader under a fresh higher epoch.
Elect(r) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = r
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < 3 THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<atGate, inTransit, delivered, msgs>>

\* A claimed bag is picked up and its slot recycled back to the gate.
Recycle(b) ==
    /\ b \in delivered
    /\ delivered' = delivered \ {b}
    /\ atGate' = atGate \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, inTransit, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Route(b)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : DeliverMsg(m)
    \/ Fail
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Elect(r)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Recycle(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Routers \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..3
    /\ atGate \subseteq Bags
    /\ inTransit \subseteq Bags
    /\ delivered \subseteq Bags
    /\ msgs \subseteq [bag : Bags, ep : 0..3]

\* Every bag sits in exactly one of the three zones: none is duplicated or lost
\* as it is routed, even across leader failover and reordered deliveries.
BagsConserved ==
    Cardinality(atGate) + Cardinality(inTransit) + Cardinality(delivered) = Cardinality(Bags)

====
nl:
An airport baggage router moves a fixed set of bags through three zones: the gate, the belt (in transit), and the claim carousel (delivered). One router acts as elected leader; only the leader routes a bag off the gate onto the belt, posting a delivery message tagged with the current epoch. Delivery messages may be consumed in any order (messages can be reordered), each moving its bag from the belt to the carousel. The leader can fail, halting routing, after which failover elects a successor under a fresh higher epoch. A bag that reaches the carousel is picked up and its slot recycled back to the gate. Bags are only moved between zones, never copied or discarded.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every bag occupies exactly one of the three zones at all times, so the total count of bags is conserved through routing, reordering, and failover.

---- MODULE W4Od13m3p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
Machines == {"m1", "m2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, grant, confirmed, msgs

vars == <<leader, epoch, grant, confirmed, msgs>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = "m1"
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ grant = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ confirmed = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ msgs = {}

\* The leader reserves a free slot for a machine and posts a grant message.
Grant(s, m) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ grant[s] = NONE
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = m]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[slot |-> s, mach |-> m, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, confirmed>>

\* A machine confirms a grant message (arriving in any order), taking the slot.
Confirm(msg) ==
    /\ msg \in msgs
    /\ confirmed[msg.slot] = NONE
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![msg.slot] = msg.mach]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {msg}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, grant>>

\* Release a slot once its dispense is done, freeing both reservation and holder.
Release(s) ==
    /\ confirmed[s] # NONE
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ msgs' = {msg \in msgs : msg.slot # s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch>>

\* The leader machine fails.
Fail ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grant, confirmed, msgs>>

\* Failover elects a new leader at a higher epoch.
Elect(m) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = m
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < 3 THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, confirmed, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, m \in Machines : Grant(s, m)
    \/ \E msg \in msgs : Confirm(msg)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ Fail
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Elect(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Machines \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..3
    /\ grant \in [Slots -> Machines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ confirmed \in [Slots -> Machines \cup {NONE}]
    /\ msgs \subseteq [slot : Slots, mach : Machines, ep : 0..3]

\* A slot's confirmed holder always matches the leader's live reservation for it:
\* no slot is ever allocated to two machines, even under reordering and failover.
GrantsAgree == \A s \in Slots : confirmed[s] # NONE => confirmed[s] = grant[s]

====
nl:
A vending machine network shares a set of product slots. One machine acts as elected leader and reserves free slots on behalf of machines, posting a grant message for each reservation. Grant messages arrive in any order (messages can be reordered); a machine confirms a grant to take the slot. When a dispense finishes the slot is released, freeing both the reservation and the holder and discarding any stale messages for it. The leader can fail, and failover elects a new leader at a higher epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A slot's confirmed holder always matches the leader's current reservation for that slot, so the same slot is never allocated to two machines despite reordering and failover.

---- MODULE W4Od7m2p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Parts == {"p1", "p2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES cphase, votes, msgs, committed, placed

vars == <<cphase, votes, msgs, committed, placed>>

Init ==
    /\ cphase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [p \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ committed = FALSE
    /\ placed = FALSE

\* Coordinator opens a round, soliciting prepare votes from all cranes.
Prepare ==
    /\ cphase = "idle"
    /\ cphase' = "collecting"
    /\ votes' = [p \in Parts |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<msgs, committed, placed>>

\* A crane emits its vote as a message.
CastVote(p, v) ==
    /\ cphase = "collecting"
    /\ ~ \E m \in msgs : m.part = p
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[part |-> p, v |-> v]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cphase, votes, committed, placed>>

\* The coordinator records a vote message; votes may arrive in any order.
DeliverVote(m) ==
    /\ cphase = "collecting"
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ votes[m.part] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m.part] = m.v]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cphase, committed, placed>>

\* Unanimous yes latches the commit permanently; any no aborts the round.
Commit ==
    /\ cphase = "collecting"
    /\ \A p \in Parts : votes[p] = "yes"
    /\ committed' = TRUE
    /\ cphase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, msgs, placed>>

Abort ==
    /\ cphase = "collecting"
    /\ \E p \in Parts : votes[p] = "no"
    /\ cphase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, msgs, committed, placed>>

\* The irreversible crane placement: performed at most once, only after commit.
Place ==
    /\ committed
    /\ ~placed
    /\ placed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cphase, votes, msgs, committed>>

\* Coordinator recycles for the next batch; the commit and placement latches stay.
Reset ==
    /\ cphase = "decided"
    /\ cphase' = "idle"
    /\ msgs' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, committed, placed>>

Next ==
    \/ Prepare
    \/ \E p \in Parts, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(p, v)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : DeliverVote(m)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Place
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ cphase \in {"idle", "collecting", "decided"}
    /\ votes \in [Parts -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ msgs \subseteq [part : Parts, v : {"yes", "no"}]
    /\ committed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ placed \in BOOLEAN

\* The irreversible placement is set only after the commit latch is set:
\* the crane placement never happens without a successful two-phase commit.
PlaceOnlyOnCommit == placed => committed

====
nl:
A container-ship crane yard uses two-phase commit to place a container batch. A coordinator opens a round and solicits prepare votes from the participating cranes; each crane emits its vote as a message, and the votes may arrive at the coordinator in any order (messages can be reordered). If all cranes vote yes the batch is committed, and if any votes no it is aborted. The irreversible crane placement is performed at most once and only after the commit latch is set; both the commit and placement latches are permanent. The coordinator then recycles for the next batch, but neither irreversible latch is ever cleared.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible placement is only ever performed under a committed decision, so it never happens without a successful two-phase commit and never more than once.

---- MODULE W4Od14m5p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Drones == {"d1", "d2"}
Approvers == {"a1", "a2", "a3"}
BUDGET == 4
QUORUM == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES reserve, charge, ballots, req, phase

vars == <<reserve, charge, ballots, req, phase>>

Charged == charge["d1"] + charge["d2"]

Init ==
    /\ reserve = BUDGET
    /\ charge = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ ballots = {}
    /\ req = NONE
    /\ phase = "idle"

\* A drone requests one energy unit from the shared reserve.
OpenRequest(d) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ reserve > 0
    /\ req' = d
    /\ ballots' = {}
    /\ phase' = "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, charge>>

\* An approver signs off on the open request at most once.
Approve(a) ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ a \notin ballots
    /\ ballots' = ballots \cup {a}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, charge, req, phase>>

\* With a quorum of approvals, one unit moves from the reserve to the drone.
GrantQuorum ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ Cardinality(ballots) >= QUORUM
    /\ reserve > 0
    /\ reserve' = reserve - 1
    /\ charge' = [charge EXCEPT ![req] = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, req>>

\* A privileged admin overrides the quorum and grants the unit directly.
AdminGrant ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ reserve > 0
    /\ reserve' = reserve - 1
    /\ charge' = [charge EXCEPT ![req] = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, req>>

\* A drone returns a unit of charge to the reserve when idle.
ReturnCharge(d) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ charge[d] > 0
    /\ charge' = [charge EXCEPT ![d] = @ - 1]
    /\ reserve' = reserve + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, req, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : OpenRequest(d)
    \/ \E a \in Approvers : Approve(a)
    \/ GrantQuorum
    \/ AdminGrant
    \/ \E d \in Drones : ReturnCharge(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ reserve \in 0..BUDGET
    /\ charge \in [Drones -> 0..BUDGET]
    /\ ballots \subseteq Approvers
    /\ req \in Drones \cup {NONE}
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "open"}

\* Energy is only moved between the reserve and the drones, never created or
\* destroyed: the reserve plus all drone charge always equals the fixed budget.
EnergyConserved == reserve + Charged = BUDGET

====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm draws survey energy from a shared reserve. A drone requests one energy unit, opening it to a vote; approvers sign off, and with a quorum of two approvals one unit is transferred from the reserve to the requesting drone. A privileged admin may override the quorum and grant the unit directly without waiting for approvals. When idle, a drone returns a unit of charge to the reserve. Energy is only moved between the reserve and the drones.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The reserve plus the total charge held across all drones always equals the fixed energy budget, so survey energy is never created or destroyed.

---- MODULE W4Od12m0p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Writers == {"w1", "w2"}
CAP == 3
NONE == 99

VARIABLES stock, version, snap, want

vars == <<stock, version, snap, want>>

Bump(x) == IF x < 3 THEN x + 1 ELSE 0

Init ==
    /\ stock = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [w \in Writers |-> NONE]
    /\ want = [w \in Writers |-> 0]

\* A writer optimistically snapshots the current version and a deposit amount.
BeginWrite(w, k) ==
    /\ snap[w] = NONE
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![w] = version]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![w] = k]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, version>>

\* Commit succeeds only if the version is unchanged and capacity allows.
CommitWrite(w) ==
    /\ snap[w] # NONE
    /\ snap[w] = version
    /\ stock + want[w] <= CAP
    /\ stock' = stock + want[w]
    /\ version' = Bump(version)
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![w] = 0]

\* A stale writer (version moved under it) re-reads and retries.
RetryWrite(w) ==
    /\ snap[w] # NONE
    /\ snap[w] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![w] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, version, want>>

\* A privileged admin adjusts stock directly, bypassing the version check but
\* still respecting the fridge capacity.
AdminAdjust(k) ==
    /\ stock + k <= CAP
    /\ stock' = stock + k
    /\ version' = Bump(version)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, want>>

\* Units are withdrawn for transfusion, lowering stock and moving the version.
Withdraw(k) ==
    /\ k <= stock
    /\ stock' = stock - k
    /\ version' = Bump(version)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, want>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers, k \in 1..2 : BeginWrite(w, k)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : CommitWrite(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : RetryWrite(w)
    \/ \E k \in 1..2 : AdminAdjust(k)
    \/ \E k \in 1..2 : Withdraw(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in 0..CAP
    /\ version \in 0..3
    /\ snap \in [Writers -> (0..3) \cup {NONE}]
    /\ want \in [Writers -> 0..2]

\* The fridge never holds more units than its capacity, whether stock is changed
\* through an optimistic commit or an admin override.
WithinCapacity == stock <= CAP

====
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards a refrigerator of bounded capacity. Writers use optimistic locking: a writer snapshots the current version and a deposit amount, and its commit succeeds only if the version is still unchanged and the capacity allows the deposit. If the version has moved under it, the writer re-reads and retries. A privileged admin may adjust the stock directly, bypassing the version check, but still respects the fridge capacity. Units are also withdrawn for transfusion, lowering the stock. Every mutation advances the version.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The refrigerator never holds more units than its capacity, whether stock is changed by an optimistic commit or an admin override.

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Banks == {"a", "b"}
Txns == {"t1", "t2", "t3"}
CAP == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, batch, settled

vars == <<leader, epoch, batch, settled>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = "a"
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ batch = {}
    /\ settled = {}

\* The leader admits an unsettled transaction into the current batch, provided
\* the batch has not reached its capacity.
Admit(t) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ t \notin batch
    /\ t \notin settled
    /\ Cardinality(batch) < CAP
    /\ batch' = batch \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, settled>>

\* Flush the batch: every batched transaction is settled and the batch clears.
Settle ==
    /\ batch # {}
    /\ settled' = settled \cup batch
    /\ batch' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch>>

\* The leader bank fails.
Fail ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, batch, settled>>

\* Failover elects a new leader bank at a higher epoch.
Elect(x) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = x
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < 3 THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batch, settled>>

\* A privileged admin admits a transaction bypassing the leader, but still
\* honoring the batch capacity.
AdminAdmit(t) ==
    /\ t \notin batch
    /\ t \notin settled
    /\ Cardinality(batch) < CAP
    /\ batch' = batch \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, settled>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Admit(t)
    \/ Settle
    \/ Fail
    \/ \E x \in Banks : Elect(x)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : AdminAdmit(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Banks \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..3
    /\ batch \subseteq Txns
    /\ settled \subseteq Txns

\* The settlement batch never holds more transactions than its capacity, whether
\* they were admitted by the leader or by an admin override.
BatchWithinCap == Cardinality(batch) <= CAP

====
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement system assembles transactions into a batch of bounded capacity. One bank acts as elected leader and admits an unsettled transaction into the current batch only while the batch has not reached its capacity. Flushing the batch settles every transaction in it and clears the batch. The leader bank can fail, and failover elects a new leader at a higher epoch. A privileged admin may admit a transaction bypassing the leader, but still honors the batch capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The settlement batch never holds more transactions than its capacity, whether admitted by the leader or by an admin override.

---- MODULE W4Od17m0p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
CAP == 3
NONE == 99

VARIABLES load, version, snap, want, crashed

vars == <<load, version, snap, want, crashed>>

Bump(x) == IF x < 3 THEN x + 1 ELSE 0

Init ==
    /\ load = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [w \in Workers |-> NONE]
    /\ want = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* A live worker snapshots the carousel version and how many bags it will add.
BeginLoad(w, k) ==
    /\ w \notin crashed

    /\ paid = FALSE

\* An instance proposes an irreversible payout from the shared pool, opening a
\* quorum vote.
Propose(i) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<approvedLatch, paid, pool>>

\* A voter casts a ballot once per round.
Vote(v, b) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[v] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![v] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, approvedLatch, paid, pool>>

\* A quorum of yes votes permanently latches approval for the payout.
Approve ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({v \in Voters : votes[v] = "yes"}) >= QUORUM
    /\ approvedLatch' = TRUE
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, paid, pool>>

\* A quorum of no votes ends the round without approval.
Reject ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ Cardinality({v \in Voters : votes[v] = "no"}) >= QUORUM
    /\ phase' = "decided"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, approvedLatch, paid, pool>>

\* The irreversible payout: executed at most once and only after approval.
Pay ==
    /\ approvedLatch
    /\ ~paid
    /\ pool >= AMT
    /\ pool' = pool - AMT
    /\ paid' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, votes, approvedLatch>>

\* Recycle for another round; the approval and payout latches are permanent.
Reset ==
    /\ phase = "decided"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, approvedLatch, paid, pool>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Propose(i)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, b \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(v, b)
    \/ Approve
    \/ Reject
    \/ Pay
    \/ Reset

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "decided"}
    /\ votes \in [Voters -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ approvedLatch \in BOOLEAN
    /\ paid \in BOOLEAN
    /\ pool \in 0..INIT

\* The irreversible payout is only ever executed after a quorum latched approval,
\* so it never happens without approval and never more than once.
PayOnlyIfApproved == paid => approvedLatch

nl:
Two independent interbank settlement instances share one fund pool. An instance proposes an irreversible payout from the shared pool, opening a quorum vote. Voters cast ballots, and a quorum of yes votes permanently latches approval for the payout, while a quorum of no votes ends the round without approval. The irreversible payout is executed at most once and only after approval has latched, debiting the shared pool. The system then recycles for another round, but both the approval and payout latches are permanent and never cleared.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible payout is only ever executed after a quorum has latched approval, so it never happens without approval and never more than once.

    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ book < cap
    /\ book' = book + 1
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

\* A resting order is cancelled, freeing a book slot.

    /\ book > 0
    /\ book' = book - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap, sealed>>

    /\ k >= book
    /\ k >= 1 /\ k <= MAXCAP
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, book, sealed>>

    /\ ~sealed
    /\ sealed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, book, cap>>

    /\ sealed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, book, cap>>

    \/ Rest
    \/ Cancel
    \/ \E k \in 1..MAXCAP : ChangeCap(k)
    \/ Seal

    /\ book \in 0..MAXCAP

    /\ p \notin msgs
    /\ p \notin bounced

Dispatch ==
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {Head(queue)}
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lobby, bounced>>

\* A join message is processed (in any order), seating the player if the lobby
\* has room below capacity.
ProcessJoin(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ lobby < CAP
    /\ lobby' = lobby + 1
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, bounced>>

\* A join message that arrives to a full lobby is bounced back.
Bounce(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ lobby >= CAP
    /\ bounced' = bounced \cup {m}
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, lobby>>

\* A seated player leaves the lobby, freeing a seat.
Leave ==
    /\ lobby > 0
    /\ lobby' = lobby - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, msgs, bounced>>

\* A bounced player is returned to the available set to try again later.
Requeue(p) ==
    /\ p \in bounced
    /\ bounced' = bounced \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, msgs, lobby>>

    \/ \E p \in Players : Enqueue(p)
    \/ Dispatch
    \/ \E m \in msgs : ProcessJoin(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Bounce(m)
    \/ Leave
    \/ \E p \in Players : Requeue(p)

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Players)
    /\ msgs \subseteq Players
    /\ lobby \in 0..CAP
    /\ bounced \subseteq Players

\* messages are processed out of order.

nl:

The head player is dispatched as a join message into the network. A seated player can leave the lobby, freeing a seat. A bounced player is returned to the available set to try again later.

    /\ pending' = PNONE

AMT == 1
INIT == 3

    /\ pool = INIT
    /\ batch = 0

CASClaim(p) ==
    /\ reg = "open"
    /\ reg' = "claimed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<posted, pool, batch>>

\* CAS winner (register already claimed), debiting the pool.
Post ==
    /\ reg = "claimed"
    /\ ~posted
    /\ pool >= AMT
    /\ posted' = TRUE
    /\ pool' = pool - AMT
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, batch>>

AdminPost ==
    /\ ~posted
    /\ pool >= AMT
    /\ reg' = "claimed"
    /\ posted' = TRUE
    /\ pool' = pool - AMT
    /\ UNCHANGED batch

\* Once the batch's register is claimed, roll over to the next batch, reopening
\* the register and clearing the per-batch post flag.
NextBatch ==
    /\ reg = "claimed"
    /\ reg' = "open"
    /\ posted' = FALSE
    /\ batch' = Bump(batch)
    /\ UNCHANGED pool

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Parties : CASClaim(p)
    \/ Post
    \/ AdminPost
    \/ NextBatch

    /\ reg \in {"open", "claimed"}
    /\ posted \in BOOLEAN
    /\ pool \in 0..INIT
    /\ batch \in 0..MAXBATCH

\* so a settlement is never posted without winning the compare-and-swap.

A bank's interbank settlement batch is finalized through a compare-and-swap register. A party compare-and-swaps the register from open to claimed, winning the sole right to post this settlement batch; only one such CAS can succeed. The irreversible settlement post is then performed at most once per batch, only by the CAS winner while the register is claimed, debiting the shared pool. Once a batch's register is claimed, the system rolls over to the next batch, reopening the register and clearing the per-batch post flag.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible post is only ever recorded once the register has been claimed, so a settlement is never posted without winning the compare-and-swap.
